description: This file defines functions and data structures for reading and parsing network routing table information from the Linux /proc filesystem, specifically the 'net/route' file, including parsing each route line into a structured format.

classes.name: NetRouteLine
classes.description: Represents a single line from the network route table, containing fields such as interface name, destination, gateway, flags, and other routing metrics.

methods.name: FS.NetRoute
methods.description: Retrieves the network route table by reading and parsing the 'net/route' file.

methods.name: readNetRoute
methods.description: Reads the route file from the specified path and returns a slice of NetRouteLine structures.

methods.name: parseNetRoute
methods.description: Parses the contents of the route file into a slice of NetRouteLine structures.

methods.name: parseNetRouteLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of route data into a NetRouteLine structure, converting string fields into appropriate types.
